body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes multiple field renderer display bugs that caused lookup, user, status, and select fields to show raw IDs instead of human-readable labels across grid and detail views. The root cause was a combination of missing primitive ID resolution logic, incorrect null checks, wrong renderer mappings, and missing field type registrations.

**Changes:**
- Fixed `LookupCellRenderer` to resolve primitive IDs via `field.options` and handle null/empty values correctly
- Fixed `UserCellRenderer` to handle primitive user IDs gracefully instead of attempting to access object properties
- Fixed `TextCellRenderer` to correctly display numeric zero instead of treating it as a falsy empty value
- Corrected `getCellRenderer` standardMap to use `LookupCellRenderer` for lookup/master_detail types
- Added explicit field registry entries for status, user, and owner types
- Added comprehensive test coverage with 36 new unit tests

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/fields/src/index.tsx | Core renderer fixes: LookupCellRenderer now resolves primitive IDs via options; UserCellRenderer handles primitives; TextCellRenderer null check fixed; standardMap corrected; explicit registrations added for status/user/owner |
| packages/fields/src/__tests__/cell-renderers.test.tsx | Added 36 tests covering registry assertions, TextCellRenderer edge cases (null/zero/false), LookupCellRenderer ID resolution, and UserCellRenderer primitive handling |
| ROADMAP.md | Documented the 5 defects, fixes, and test additions with technical details |

Duplicate test case detected. There's already a test case with the same name "should return SelectCellRenderer for status type" at lines 40-51 (outside this diff but in the same file). The earlier test performs a more comprehensive check by rendering the component and verifying the output, while this one only checks the renderer identity. Consider either removing this duplicate or renaming it to clarify the specific aspect being tested (e.g., "should return correct renderer identity for status type").
```suggestion
  it('should return correct renderer identity for status type', () => {
```

Inconsistent fallback for objects without name/label/_id properties. In the array case (line 557), the code uses `String(item)` as the final fallback, but in the single object case (line 575), it uses `'[Object]'` as the literal string. This inconsistency could lead to different display behaviors for the same type of data. Consider using `String(value)` instead of `'[Object]'` at line 575 to maintain consistency with the array handling logic, or use `'[Object]'` in both places if that's the preferred behavior.

Potential issue with falsy value check. The condition `if (!value)` at line 598 will return "-" for a user ID of `0`, which could be a valid user ID in some systems. This is inconsistent with the LookupCellRenderer (line 537) which was updated to use `if (value == null || value === '')` to handle numeric zero correctly. Consider updating this to `if (value == null || value === '')` for consistency, or at minimum `if (value == null)` to only catch null/undefined values. ```suggestion if (value == null || value === '') return -; ```
